seoTitle: robots.txt Compliance Log Checker: Bots Ignoring Rules
metaDescription: Cross-reference access log hits with your robots.txt to find crawlers that requested disallowed paths. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: Applies your robots.txt to the bot requests in a log and counts the ones that hit disallowed paths.
why:
A rule in robots.txt only helps if crawlers follow it. Your logs show who does not: bots that request paths you disallowed.

Paste the robots.txt and a combined-format log. Bots with a named group are judged by it, the rest by the * group. Caveats are listed: the rules may have changed after the visit, crawlers cache robots.txt, and user-triggered fetchers are expected to ignore it.
howTo: Read hits on disallowed paths per bot.
Block repeat offenders at the server.

faq.a: The request got a status below 400, so the content was delivered.

faq.q: Why might a compliant bot show hits?
faq.a: It may have cached an older robots.txt from before your change.
They act for a user and may not follow robots.txt by design.
